hook.say: If your desktop is literally drowning in lecture PDFs you are never opening again, listen up.

beats.say: Rereading them feels like studying, then you just blank when the midterm hits.
Instead of spending hours making flashcards by hand, just drop your notes right into Kiln.
It turns them into actual exam questions, and every answer links right back to the exact line.
Drop tonight's lecture notes into Kiln and quiz yourself before bed.

caption: stop rereading the same pdf for four hours
